findings: 3900 is Tencent shares per elective TME ADS for qualifying whole lots, not universally applicable proportional split adjustment; inverse direction explicitly defined

Election applies to all but not part of entitled ADSs; cash election rounded down to HKD; fractional ADS not distributed; residual whole500-share cash rule and below1500 no-payment threshold preserved in original-page facts
Eligibility excludes specified persons/jurisdictions and TencentMusicAffiliates; do not apply qualifying-shareholder formula to every account
2018-12-28 ex-date and2019-02-20 distribution in declaration are expected timetable; declaration status approved does not claim actual settlement
Actual settled record links earlier declaration but leaves ratio and exact payment_date null; inclusive2019-02-01..28 is valid month interval, not invented paymentday
2020-04-02 announcement_date/event_date on confirmation are year-report public release, not historical paymentdate; historical availability bounded by actual source publication
limitations: This review does not implement tax/account-level entitlement computation or total-return adjustment
The archived Jan2019 circular is corroborating context, not a claim all its eligibility clauses are normalized
Declaration metadata publication must be known for historical/live queries; do not treat approval of source extraction as time completeness
